title: Entry point for Game Activity
description: From the Xbox dashboard, open the Guide and enter the selected game's Game Activity view. Navigate through Achievements, Stats, and Go to official club, verifying each destination before returning to the dashboard. The selected game's name must remain visible wherever the destination screen identifies the game.
goal: Open the Guide, press Right to reach the selected game's Game Activity section, open Achievements and verify the selected game name and achievement content, return and open Stats and verify game statistics, return and open Go to official club and verify the game's official club, then return to the dashboard and verify the dashboard is visible.
preconditions: The console is powered on and showing the Xbox dashboard
The selected game is installed and represented by the focused dashboard tile
The user is signed in to Xbox
The capture card is connected and no other application is using it
If the Guide overlay is already open (for example after a replan), do not press Guide again, because that closes it; press B until the Guide's top level is visible, then continue from there

success_criteria.description: The Xbox Guide overlay opens and the selected game's Game Activity section is reached by pressing Right from the initial Guide position. The Game Activity heading or equivalent game activity controls are visibly present.

parameters.expected_screen: Xbox Guide with the selected game's Game Activity section

success_criteria.description: The Achievements destination is opened from Game Activity. The selected game's name and achievement content, such as achievement progress, unlocked achievements, or the achievements heading, are visible.
After returning to Game Activity, the Stats destination is opened and the selected game's statistics content is visible.
After returning to Game Activity, Go to official club is opened and the selected game's official club page or official club identity is visible.
After returning from the official club, the Xbox dashboard is visible again and the selected game tile or dashboard shell is recognizable.
No error dialog, unavailable-service message, or 'Something went wrong' message appears during the Game Activity journey.
